G2216.def:
**Ζοροβάβελ** (FlJ, Ζοροβάβηλος, -ου), ὁ indecl. (Heb. זְרֻבָּבֶל),
Zerubbabel ([[1Ch.3.19|1Ch.3:19]], al.): [[Mat.1.12-13|Mat.1:12-13]] [[Luk.3.27|Luk.3:27]].†
(AS)

G2250.def:
**ἡμέρα**, -ας, ἡ,
[in LXX chiefly (very freq.) for יוֹם ;]
**day**;
1. **as distinct from night**: genitive ἡμέρας, **by day** (WM, §30, 11), [[Rev.21.25|Rev.21:25]] ἡ. κ. νυκτός (ν. κ. ̔ἡ.), [[Act.9.24|Act.9:24]], [[1Th.2.9|1Th.2:9]], [[2Th.3.8|2Th.3:8]], [[Rev.4.8|Rev.4:8]] (BL, §36, 13); ἡμέρας μέσης, **at mid-day**, [[Act.26.13|Act.26:13]] accusative durat., τ. ἡμέρας, [[Luk.21.37|Luk.21:37]] ὅλην τὴν ἡ., [[Rom.8.36|Rom.8:36]] ἐν ἡμέρα, [[Jhn.11.9|Jhn.11:9]], [[Rom.13.13|Rom.13:13]]; ἡμέρας ὁδός, **a day's journey**, [[Luk.2.44|Luk.2:44]] ἡ. γίνεται, [[Luk.4.42; 22.66|Lk 4:42 22:66]]; κλίνει, [[Luk.9.12|Luk.9:12]], al.; metaphorically, [[Jhn.9.4|Jhn.9:4]], [[Rom.13.12|Rom.13:12]], [[1Th.5.4|1Th.5:4]], 5 8, [[2Pe.1.19|2Pe.1:19]]
2. Of a civil day of 24 hours, incl. night: [[Mat.6.34|Mat.6:34]], [[Mrk.6.21|Mrk.6:21]], [[Luk.13.14|Luk.13:14]], al.; τρίτῃ ἡ., [[Mat.16.21|Mat.16:21]] ἡμέρᾳ κ. ἡ. (cf. יוֹם בְּיוֹם, [[Est.3.4|Est.3:4]]), [[2Co.4.16|2Co.4:16]]; ὅλην τ. ἡ., [[Rom.8.36; 10.21|Rom.8:36 10:21]]; pl., [[Jhn.2.12|Jhn.2:12]], [[Act.9.19|Act.9:19]], al.; ἡ. τῶν ἀζύμων, [[Act.12.3|Act.12:3]] τ. σαββάτου, [[Luk.13.14, 16|Luk.13:14, 16]]; ἡ κυριάκη ἡ., [[Rev.1.10|Rev.1:10]]
3. **In Messianic sense, of the last day**: ἡ ἡ. (ἐκείνη, τ. κυρίου, etc.), [[Mat.7.22|Mat.7:22]], [[Luk.6.23|Luk.6:23]], [[Rom.13.12|Rom.13:12]], [[1Co.1.8|1Co.1:8]], [[1Th.5.2|1Th.5:2]], [[2Th.2.2|2Th.2:2]], [[2Pe.3.10|2Pe.3:10]], al; by meton., as compared with the divine judgment on that day, ἡ. ἀνθρωπίνη, of a human **tribunal**, [[1Co.4.3|1Co.4:3]] (EV, **man's judgment**).
4. As in Heb. (also in Gk. writers; Bl, §46, 9; M, _Pr._, 81), of time in general: [[Jhn.8.56; 14.20|Jhn.8:56 14:20]], [[2Co.6.2|2Co.6:2]], [[Eph.6.13|Eph.6:13]], [[2Pe.3.18|2Pe.3:18]]; pl. [[Act.15.7|Act.15:7]], [[Eph.5.16|Eph.5:16]], [[Heb.10.32|Heb.10:32]]; πᾶσας τὰς ἡ. (cf. כָּל הַיָּמִים, [[Deu.4.40|Deu.4:40]], al.; MM, _Exp._, xv), [[Mat.28.20|Mat.28:20]] ἐλεύσονται ἡ. ὅταν (ὅτε), [[Mat.9.15|Mat.9:15]], [[Mrk.2.20|Mrk.2:20]], [[Luk.5.35; 17.22|Luk.5:35 17:22]]; αἱ ἡ., with genitive of person(s) ([[Gen.26.1|Gen.26:1]], al.), [[Mat.2.1|Mat.2:1]], [[Luke.1.5|Luk.1:5]], [[Act.7.45|Act.7:45]], [[1Pe.3.20|1Pe.3:20]]; ἀρχ̀ ἡμερῶν, [[Heb.7.3|Heb.7:3]]
(AS)

G2232.def:
**ἡγεμών**, -όνος, ὁ
(ἡγέομαι) [in LXX for אַלּוּף, שַׂר, etc. ;]
1. a leader, guide.
2. a commander.
3. **a governor of a province **(pro­consul, proprietor, legate, or procurator; but cf. ἀνθύπατος): [[Mat.10.18|Mat.10:18]], [[Mrk.13.9|Mrk.13:9]], [[Luk.21.12|Luk.21:12]], [[1Pe.2.14|1Pe.2:14]]; of the Procurator of Judæa, [[Mat.27.2, 11; 27.14-15, 21; 27.27; 28.14|Mat.27:2, 11 27:14-15, 21 27:27 28:14]], [[Luk.20.20|Luk.20:20]], [[Act.23.24, 26; 23.33; 24.1, 10; 26.30|Act.23:24, 26 23:33 24:1, 10 26:30]].
4. For _Heb._ אַלְפֵי (LXX, χίλιαι) misread אַלֻּפֵי, **leaders**: [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]] (OT).†
(AS)

G2233.def:
**ἡγέομαι**, -οῦμαι depon. mid.,
[in LXX (chiefly Pres. ptcp.) for נָגִיד, רֹאשׁ, שַׂר, etc. ;]
1. **to lead**;
(a) **to guide, go before**;
(b) **to rule, be leader**: present ptcp., ἡγούενος, a ruler, leader (MM, _Exp._, xiv), [[Mat.2.6|Mat.2:6]] (LXX), [[Luk.22.26|Luk.22:26]], [[Act.7.10; 14.12; 15.22|Act.7:10 14:12 15:22]], [[Heb.13.7, 17; 13.24|Heb.13:7, 17 13:24]].
2. **to suppose, believe, consider, think **(Hdt., Soph., al.; of. Lat. duco): with dupl. accusative, [[Act.26.2|Act.26:2]], [[Php.2.3, 6; 3.7|Php.2:3, 6 3:7]], [[1Ti.1.12; 6.1|1Ti.1:12 6:1]], [[Heb.10.29; 11.11, 26|Heb.10:29 11:11, 26]], [[2Pe.1.13; 2.13; 3.9; 3.15|2Pe.1:13 2:13 3:9 3:15]]; with accusative before ὡς, with accusative, [[2Th.3.15|2Th.3:15]] with accusative before adv., [[1Th.5.13|1Th.5:13]] ὅταν, [[Jas.1.2|Jas.1:2]] ἀναγκαῖον, with inf., [[2Co.9.5|2Co.9:5]], [[Php.2.25|Php.2:25]]; δίκαιον, with inf., [[2Pe.1.13|2Pe.1:13]] with accusative and inf., [[Php.3.8|Php.3:8]] (of. δι-, ἐκ-δι-, ἐξ- προ-ηγέομαι).†
_SYN._: see: δοκέω (AS)

G2212.def:
**ζητέω**, -ῶ,
[in LXX chiefly for בּקשׁ pi., also for דּרשׁ, etc. ;]
1. **to seek, seek for**: [[Mat.7.7|Mat.7:7]], 8 [[Luk.11.9|Luk.11:9]], 10; with accusative of person(s), [[Mrk.1.37|Mrk.1:37]], [[Luk.2.48|Luk.2:48]], [[Jhn.6.24|Jhn.6:24]], al.; id. before ἐν, [[Act.9.11|Act.9:11]] with accusative of thing(s), [[Mat.13.45|Mat.13:45]], [[Luk.19.10|Luk.19:10]]; before ἐν, [[Luk.13.6|Luk.13:6]], 7; ψυχήν, of plotting against one's life ( [[Exo.4.19|Exo.4:19]], al.), [[Mat.2.20|Mat.2:20]], [[Rom.11.3|Rom.11:3]]" (LXX) . Metaphorical, **to seek** by thinking, **search after, inquire into**: [[Mrk.11.18|Mrk.11:18]], [[Luk.12.28|Luk.12:28]], [[John.16.19|Jhn.16:19]]; τ. θεόν, [[Act.17.27|Act.17:27]]
2. **to seek** or **strive after, desire**: [[Mat.12.46|Mat.12:46]], [[Mrk.12.12|Mrk.12:12]], [[Luk.9.9|Luk.9:9]], [[Jhn.5.18|Jhn.5:18]], [[Rom.10.3|Rom.10:3]], al.; τ. θάνατον, [[Rev.9.6|Rev.9:6]] τ. βασιλείαν τ. θεοῦ, [[Mat.6.33|Mat.6:33]] (Dalman, _Words_, 121f.); τὰ ἄνω, [[Col.3.1|Col.3:1]] εἰρήνην, [[1Pe.3.11|1Pe.3:11]] (LXX).
3. **to require, demand**: with accusative of thing(s), [[Mrk.8.12|Mrk.8:12]], [[Luk.11.29|Luk.11:29]], [[1Co.1.22|1Co.1:22]], [[2Co.13.3|2Co.13:3]]; before παρά, [[Mrk.8.11|Mrk.8:11]], al.; ἵνα, [[1Co.4.2|1Co.4:2]] (cf. ἀνα-, ἐκ-, ἐπι-, συν-ζητέω).
(AS)

G2223.def:
**ζώνη**, -ης, ἡ
(ζώννυμι) [in LXX for אַבְנֵט, חֲגוֹר, etc. ;]
**a belt, girdle**: [[Mat.3.4|Mat.3:4]], [[Mrk.1.6|Mrk.1:6]], [[Act.21.11|Act.21:11]], [[Rev.1.13; 15.6|Rev.1:13 15:6]]; as a receptacle for money, [[Mat.10.9|Mat.10:9]], [[Mrk.6.8|Mrk.6:8]].†
(AS)

G2235.def:
**ἤδη **
_adv._,
**in NT, always of time; now, already**: [[Mat.3.10|Mat.3:10]], [[Mrk.4.37|Mrk.4:37]], [[Luk.7.6|Luk.7:6]], [[Jhn.4.36|Jhn.4:36]], al.; νῦν . . . ἤ., now already, [[1Jn.4.3|1Jn.4:3]] ἤ. ποτέ, now at length, with fut., [[Rom.1.10|Rom.1:10]] (cf. ἄρτι)
(AS)

G2281.def:
**θάλασσα**, -ης, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for יָם ;]
**the sea**: [[Mat.23.15|Mat.23:15]], [[Mrk.11.23|Mrk.11:23]], [[Luk.21.25|Luk.21:25]], [[Rom.9.27|Rom.9:27]], [[Heb.11.12|Heb.11:12]], [[Jas.1.6|Jas.1:6]], [[Jude.13|Ju 13]], [[Rev.7.1|Rev.7:1]], al.; τὸ πέλαγος τῆς θ. (see Tr., ut infr.), [[Mat.18.6|Mat.18:6]] ὁ οὐρανὸς κ. ἡ γῆ κ. ἡ θ., of the whole world, [[Act.4.24|Act.4:24]], al. ([[Hag.2.7|Hag.2:7]]); θ. ὑαλίνη, [[Rev.4.6; 15.2|Rev.4:6 15:2]]; of the Mediterranean, [[Act.10.6, 32; 17.14|Act.10:6, 32 17:14]]; of the Red Sea, ἐρυθρὰ θ., [[Act.7.36|Act.7:36]], [[1Co.10.1-2|1Co.10:1-2]], [[Heb.11.20|Heb.11:20]]; of an inland lake (as _Heb._ יָם), θ. τ. Γαλιλαίας, [[Mat.4.18; 15.29|Mat.4:18 15:29]], [[Mrk.1.16; 7.31|Mrk.1:16 7:31]]; τ. Τιβεριάδος, [[Jhn.21.1|Jhn.21:1]] τ. Γ. τ. T., [[Jhn.6.1|Jhn.6:1]] of the same, simply ἡ θ., [[Mat.4.15|Mat.4:15]], [[Mrk.2.13|Mrk.2:13]], al
_SYN._: πέλαγος, the vast expanse of open water"; θ., "the sea as contrasted with the land" (Tr., _Syn._, xiii) (AS)

G2288.def:
**θάνατος**, -ου, ὁ (θνήσκω),
[in LXX chiefly for מָוֶת ,מוּת, sometimes דֶּבֶר ;]
**death**;
1. **of the death of the body, whether natural or violent**: [[Jhn.11.13|Jhn.11:13]], [[Php.2.27|Php.2:27]], [[Heb.7.23|Heb.7:23]], al; opposite to ζωή, [[Rom.8.38|Rom.8:38]], [[Php.1.20|Php.1:20]]; of the death of Christ, [[Rom.5.10|Rom.5:10]], [[Php.3.10|Php.3:10]], [[Heb.2.9|Heb.2:9]]; ῥυέσθαι (σώζειν) ἐκ θ., [[2Co.1.10|2Co.1:10]], [[Heb.5.7|Heb.5:7]]; περίλυπος ἕως θανάτου, [[Mat.26.38|Mat.26:38]], [[Mrk.14.34|Mrk.14:34]]; μέχρι (ἄχρι), [[Php.2.8|Php.2:8]], [[Rev.2.10|Rev.2:10]]; πληγὴ θανάτου, a deadly wound. [[Rev.13.3|Rev.13:3]] ἰδεῖν θάνατον, [[Luk.2.26|Luk.2:26]], [[Heb.11.5|Heb.11:5]]; γεύεσθαι θανάτου, [[Mrk.9.1|Mrk.9:1]] ἔνοχος θανάτου, [[Mrk.14.64|Mrk.14:64]] θανάτῳ τελευτᾶν ( [[Exo.21.17|Exo.21:17]], מוּת יוּמָת), [[Mrk.7.10|Mrk.7:10]] death personified, [[Rom.6.9|Rom.6:9]], [[1Co.15.26|1Co.15:26]], [[Rev.21.4|Rev.21:4]]; pl., of deadly perils, [[2Co.11.23|2Co.11:23]]
2. **Of spiritual death**: [[Jhn.5.24; 8.51|Jhn.5:24 8:51]], [[Rom.7.10|Rom.7:10]], [[Jas.1.15; 5.20|Jas.1:15, 5:20]], [[1Jn.3.14; 5.16|1Jn.3:14 5:16]], al.; of eternal death, [[Rom.1.32; 7.5|Rom.1:32 7:5]], al.; ὁ θ. ὁ δεύτερος, [[Rev.2.11; 21.8|Rev.2:11 21:8]] (cf. Cremer, 283ff.; _DB_, iii, 114ff.; _DCG_, i, 791f.).
(AS)

G2244.def:
**ἡλικία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἧλιξ, of the same age, mature), [in LXX: [[Ezk.13.18|Eze.13:18]] (קוֹמָה), [[Job.29.18|Job.29:18]], [[Wis.4.9|Wis.4:9]], [[Sir.26.17|Sir.26:17]], frequently in 2-4 Mac ;]
always of age or maturity; "a stage of growth whether measured by age or stature";
1. (a) **age**: [[Mat.6.27|Mat.6:27]], [[Luk.12.25|Luk.12:25]] (R, mg.), [[Heb.11.11|Heb.11:11]]
(b) **full age, maturity**: [[Jhn.9.21, 23|Jhn.9:21, 23]], [[Eph.4.13|Eph.4:13]].
2. **stature**: [[Luk.19.3|Luk.19:3]] ([[Mat.6.27|Mat.6:27]], [[Luk.12.25|Luk.12:25]], AV, R, txt.; but the prevailing usage in LXX and π. favours the former meaning in these doubtful passages; cf., Ellic., _ICC_, AR, on Eph, l.with; Milligan, _NTD_, 74 f., and esp., MM, _Exp._, xv; e contra, Field, _Notes_, 6).†
(AS)

G2222.def:
**ζωή**, -ῆς, ἡ (ζάω),
[in LXX chiefly for חַיִּים ;]
**life** (in Hom., Hdt., = βίος, which see; later, _existence, vita quâ vivimus_, as distinct from βίος, _vita quam vivimus_; opposite to θάνατος);
1. **of natural life**: [[Luk.16.25|Luk.16:25]], [[Act.8.33|Act.8:33]], [[1Co.15.19|1Co.15:19]], [[1Ti.4.8|1Ti.4:8]], [[Heb.7.3|Heb.7:3]], [[Jas.4.14|Jas.4:14]]; πνεῦμα ζωῆς, [[Rev.11.11|Rev.11:11]] ψυχὴ ζωῆς ( [[Gen.1.30|Gen.1:30]]), [[Rev.16.3|Rev.16:3]]; of the life of one risen from the dead, [[Rom.5.10|Rom.5:10]], [[Heb.7.16|Heb.7:16]].
2. **Of the life of the kingdom of God, the present life of grace and the life of glory which is to follow **(Dalman, _Words_, 156ff.; Westc, _Epp. Jo._, 214ff.; Cremer, 272ff.): [[Jhn.6.51, 53|Jhn.6:51, 53]] [[Rom.7.10; 8.6, 10|Rom.7:10 8:6, 10]] [[Php.2.16|Php.2:16]], [[Col.3.4|Col.3:4]], [[2Pe.1.3|2Pe.1:3]]; αἰώνος (reff. supr.; _DCG_, i, 538a, ii, 30f.), [[Jhn.4.36; 12.50; 17.3|Jhn.4:36 12:50 17:3]], [[1Jn.1.2|1Jn.1:2]], al.; τ. φῶς τῆς ζ., [[Jhn.8.12|Jhn.8:12]] ὁ Λόγος τ. ζ., [[1Jn.1.1|1Jn.1:1]] ὁ ἄρτος τ. ζ., [[Jhn.6.35, 48|Jo 6:35, 48]]; δικαίωσις ζωῆς, [[Rom.5.18|Rom.5:18]] μετάνοια εἰς ζ., [[Act.11.18|Act.11:18]] ἐν αὐτῷ ζ. ἦν, [[Jhn.1.4|Jhn.1:4]] ζ. ἡ ἐν. Χ. Ἰ., [[2Ti.1.1|2Ti.1:1]] τὰ πρὸς ζωήν, [[2Pe.1.3|2Pe.1:3]], al.; στέφανος τῆς ζ., [[Jas.1.12|Jas.1:12]], [[Rev.2.10|Rev.2:10]]; χάρις ζωῆς (genitive expl.), [[1Pe.3.7|1Pe.3:7]] ζ. καὶ εἰρήνη, [[Rom.8.6|Rom.8:6]] ζ. καὶ ἀφθαρσία, [[2Ti.1.10|2Ti.1:10]] ἀνάστασις ζωῆς, [[Jhn.5.29|Jhn.5:29]] βίβλος ζωῆς, [[Php.4.3|Php.4:3]], [[Rev.3.5|Rev.3:5]]; ξύλον ζωῆς, [[Rev.2.7|Rev.2:7]] ὕδωρ ζωῆς, [[Rev.22.17|Rev.22:17]] meton., of that which has life: τ. πνεῦμα, [[Rom.8.10|Rom.8:10]] ῥήματα, [[Jhn.6.63|Jhn.6:63]] of one who gives life, [[Jhn.11.25; 14.6|Jhn.11:25 14:6]], [[1Jn.1.2|1Jn.1:2]]; ἡ ἐντολή, [[Jhn.12.50|Jhn.12:50]]
_SYN._: see: βίος. (AS)

G2240.def:
**ἥκω **
[in LXX chiefly for בּוֹא ;]
pf. with present meaning (hence imperfect = plpf.), to have come, be present: [[Mat.24.50|Mat.24:50]], [[Mrk.8.3|Mrk.8:3]] (late pf., ἧκα, see Swete, in l; WH, _App._, 169), [[Luk.12.46; 15.27|Luk.12:46 15:27]], [[Jhn.8.42|Jhn.8:42]], [[Heb.10.7, 9; 10.37|Heb.10:7, 9 10:37]], I [[Jhn.5.20|Jn 5:20]], [[Rev.2.25; 3.3, 9; 15.4|Rev.2:25 3:3, 9 15:4]]; before ἀπό, with genitive loc., [[Mat.8.11|Mat.8:11]], [[Luk.13.29|Luk.13:29]]; ἐκ, [[Rom.11.26|Rom.11:26]] id. before εἰς, [[Jhn.4.47|Jhn.4:47]] μακρόθεν, [[Mrk.8.3|Mrk.8:3]] ἐπί, with accusative, [[Rev.3.3|Rev.3:3]] Metaphorical, of discipleship: [[Jhn.6.37|Jhn.6:37]] of time and events: absol., [[Mat.24.14|Mat.24:14]], [[Jhn.2.4|Jhn.2:4]], [[2Pe.3.10|2Pe.3:10]], [[Rev.18.8|Rev.18:8]]; before ἐπί with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.23.36|Mat.23:36]], [[Luk.19.43|Luk.19:43]] (cf. ἀν-, καθ-ήκω).†
(AS)

G2293.def:
**θαρσέω**, -ῶ
(see: θαρρέω), [in LXX chiefly for יָרֵא, with neg. ;]
**to be of good courage**: imperat., θάραει, -εῖτε, [[Mat.9.2, 22; 14.27|Mat.9:2, 22 14:27]], [[Mrk.6.50; 10.49|Mrk.6:50 10:49]], [[Jhn.16.33|Jhn.16:33]], [[Act.23.11|Act.23:11]].†
(AS)

G2280.def:
**Θαδδαῖος**, -ου, ὁ (Aram. תּדִאַי, תַּדַּי),
**Thaddæus**: [[Mat.10.3|Mat.10:3]], [[Mrk.3.18|Mrk.3:18]] (WH, mg., Λεββαῖος, which see).†
(AS)

G2289.def:
**θανατόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for מוּת hi., ho., also for הָרַג, etc. ;]
**to put to death**: with accusative, [[Mat.10.21; 26.59; 27.1|Mat.10:21 26:59 27:1]], [[Mrk.13.12; 14.55|Mrk.13:12 14:55]], [[Luk.21.16|Luk.21:16]], [[2Co.6.9|2Co.6:9]], [[1Pe.3.18|1Pe.3:18]]; pass., [[Rom.8.36|Rom.8:36]] Metaphorical: [[Rom.8.13|Rom.8:13]] pass., with dative, (in relation to), [[Rom.7.4|Rom.7:4]]†
(AS)

G2218.def:
**ζυγός** (in cl. more frequently τὸ ζυγόν), -οῦ, ὁ
(ζεύγνυμι), [in LXX for עֹל, מֹאזֵן, etc. ;]
1. **a yoke**; metaphorically, of bondage or submission to authority: [[Mat.11.29-30|Mat.11:29-30]], [[Act.15.10|Act.15:10]], [[Gal.5.1|Gal.5:1]], [[1Ti.6.1|1Ti.6:1]].
2. **a balance**: [[Rev.6.5|Rev.6:5]] (of. [[Isa.40.12|Isa.40:12]], al.).†
(AS)

G2215.def:
**ζιζάνιον**, -ου, τό
(in Talmud זוּנִין),
zizanium (EV, tares), a kind of darnel, **resembling wheat**: [[Mat.13.25-40|Mat.13:25-40]] (cf. _DB_, see word "Tares").†
(AS)

G2266.def:
**Ἡρῳδιάς** (Rec. Ἡρω-), -άδος, ἡ
**Herodias, granddaughter of Herod the Great**: [[Mat.14.3|Mat.14:3]], 6, [[Mrk.6.17, 19; 6.22|Mrk.6:17, 19 6:22]], [[Luk.3.19|Luk.3:19]].†
(AS)

G2210.def:
**ζημόω**, -ῶ
(ζημία), [in LXX chiefly for עָנַשׁ ;]
to damage. Pass., **to suffer loss, forfeit, lose**: absol., [[1Co.3.15|1Co.3:15]] before ἐν, [[2Co.7.9|2Co.7:9]] with accusative of thing(s) (see B1., § 34, 6), τ. ψυχήν, [[Mat.16.26|Mat.16:26]], [[Mrk.8.36|Mrk.8:36]]; ἑαυτόν, [[Luk.9.25|Luk.9:25]] τ. πάντα, [[Php.3.8|Php.3:8]]†
(AS)

G2297.def:
**θαυμάσιος**, -α, -ον
(θαῦμα), [in LXX chiefly for פָּלָא ni. (n. pl. = פָּלָא [[Jos.3.5|Jos.3:5]] ;)
**wonderful**; n. pl., **wonders**: [[Mat.21.15|Mat.21:15]]†
(AS)

G2265.def:
**Ἡρῳδιανοί** (Rec. Ἡρω-), -ῶν, οἱ,
**Herodians, partisans of Herod **(cf. τὸυς τὰ Ἡρῴδου φρονοῦνιτας, FlJ, _Ant._, xiv, 15, 10): [[Mat.22.16|Mat.22:16]], [[Mrk.3.6; 12.13|Mrk.3:6 12:13]].†
(AS)

G2241.def:
**ἡλεί** (Rec. ἠλί L, ἠλί; _Heb._ אֵל),
**Eli, my God**: [[Mat.27.46|Mat.27:46]] (cf. ἐλωΐ).†
(AS)

G2284.def:
**θαμβέω**, -ῶ
(θάμβος) [in LXX for בָּעַת ni., pi., etc. ;]
1. to be amazed.
2. In late Gk., to astonish, terrify ([[2Sa.22.5|2Ki.22:5]]): pass., [[Mrk.1.27; 10.32|Mrk.1:27 10:32]]; before ἐπί with dative of thing(s), [[Mrk.10.24|Mrk.10:24]]†
(AS)

G2234.def:
**ἡδέως **
_adv._ (ἡδύς, sweet), [in LXX: [[Pro.3.24|Pro.3:24]] (עָרַב), etc. ;]
**gladly, with pleasure**: [[Mrk.6.20; 12.37|Mrk.6:20 12:37]], [[2Co.11.19|2Co.11:19]]; superlat., ἥδιστα, very gladly (B1., § 11, 3), [[2Co.12.9; 12.15|2Co.12:9 12:15]].†
(AS)

G2255.def:
**ἥμισυς**, -εια, -υ genitive, -ους (late, as in π., for cl., -εος Bl., § 8, 4; Mayser, 294), n. p1., ἡμίσια (Rec., cl., -εια),
[in LXX for חֵצִי, מַחֲצִית ;] half;
1. as adj., agreeing in gender and number with the substantive following, τὰ ἡμίσια τ. ὑταρχόντων, [[Luk.19.8|Luk.19:8]]
2. As neut. subst., τὸ ἥμισυ, the half; ἥ. (anarth.), **a half**: with genitive, ἥ. καιροῦ, [[Rev.12.14|Rev.12:14]] ἕως ἡμίσους τ. βασιλείας μου, [[Mrk.6.23|Mrk.6:23]] after a cardinal number, ἡμέρας τρεῖς κ. ἥμισυ, [[Rev.11.9, 11|Rev.11:9, 11]].†
(AS)

G2230.def:
**ἡγεμονεύω**
(ἡγεμών),
1. to lead the way.
2. to lead in war, command (of. Ramsay, Was Christ born at Bethlehem?; _DCG_, ii, 463 f.).
3. **to be governor of a province**: with genitive loc., [[Luk.2.2; 3.1|Luk.2:2 3:1]].†
(AS)

G2201.def:
**ζεῦγος**, -εος (-ους), τό
(ζεύγνυμι, to yoke), [in LXX chiefly for צֶמֶד, [[Jdg.19.3|Jdg.19:3]], al. ;]
1. **a yoke of beasts**: [[Luk.14.19|Luk.14:19]]
2. a pair of any­thing, [[Luk.2.24|Luk.2:24]] (LXX).†
(AS)

G2242.def:
**Ἡλεί** (Rec. Ἡλί; RV, Ἡλί), ὁ, indecl.,
**Heli, Joseph's father**: [[Luk.3.23|Luk.3:23]]†
(AS)

G2262.def:
**Ἤρ** (L, Ἥρ), ὁ, indecl. (Heb. עֵר),
**Er, an ancestor of Jesus**: [[Luk.3.28|Luk.3:28]]†
(AS)

G2279.def:
**ἦχος**, -ου, ὁ
(also in late and M_Gr._, -εος, τό, [[Luk.21.25|Luk.21:25]]), [in LXX for הָמוֹן, etc. ;]
1. **a noise, sound**: [[Act.2.2|Act.2:2]] ἦ. θαλάσσης, [[Luk.21.25|Luk.21:25]] σάλπιγγος, [[Heb.12.19|Heb.12:19]]
2. **a report**: before πεφί, [[Luk.4.37|Luk.4:37]]†
(AS)

G2221.def:
**ζωγρέω**, -ῶ
(ζωός, alive, + ἀγρεύω) [in LXX chiefly for חָיָה hi. ;]
**to catch alive, take captive**: metaphorically, [[Luk.5.10|Luk.5:10]] pass., [[2Ti.2.26|2Ti.2:26]] (on the meaning and construction, see Ellic., CGT, in l).†
(AS)

G2208.def:
**Ζηλωτής**
In FlJ, NT,
**a Zealot, member of the Jewish party so called**: as surname of the Apostle Simon, [[Luk.6.15|Luk.6:15]], [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]].†
(AS)

G2237.def:
**ἡδονή**, -ῆς, ἡ
(ἥδομαι, to be glad) [in LXX: [[Num.11.8|Num.11:8]] (טַעַם), [[Pro.17.1|Pro.17:1]], [[Wis.7.2; 16.20|Wis.7:2 16:20]], and frequently in 4Mac ;]
**pleasure**: [[2Pe.2.13|2Pe.2:13]] pl., [[Luk.8.14|Luk.8:14]], [[Tit.3.3|Tit.3:3]], [[Jas.4.1|Jas.4:1]], †
(AS)

G2270.def:
**ἡσυχάζω **
[in LXX chiefly for שָׁקַט ;]
**to be still**;
(a) **to rest from labour**: [[Luk.23.56|Luk.23:56]]
(b) **to live quietly**: [[1Th.4.11|1Th.4:11]]
(with) **to be silent**: [[Luk.14.3|Luk.14:3]], [[Act.11.18; 21.14|Act.11:18 21:14]] (cf. [[Job.32.7|Job.32:7]], [[Neh.5.8|Neh.5:8]]).†
_SYN._: σιγάω (which see), σιωπάω (AS)

G2225.def:
**ζωογονέω**, -ῶ
(ζωός, alive, γένεσθαι), [in LXX [[Exo.1.17-18, 22|Exo.1:17-18, 22]], [[Jdg.8.19|Jdg.8:19]], [[1Sa.2.6; 27.9; 27.11|1Ki.2:6 27:9 27:11]], [[1Ki.20.31|3Ki.20:31]], [[2Ki.7.4|4Ki.7:4]] (חָיָה pi., hi.), [[Lev.11.47|Lev.11:47]] (חַי)* ;]
1. in cl., to engender, produce alive, endue with life.
2. In LXX. and NT, **to preserve alive **(_DCG_, ii, 606; Cremer, 274): [[Luk.17.33|Luk.17:33]], [[Act.7.19|Act.7:19]], [[1Ti.6.13|1Ti.6:13]] (EV, quickeneth; R, mg., preserveth).†
(AS)

G2214.def:
**ζήτησις**, -εως, ἡ
(ζητέω).
1. a seeking, search.
2. **a questioning, inquiry, debate**: [[Act.15.2|Act.15:2]], 7, [[2Ti.2.23|2Ti.2:23]], [[Tit.3.9|Tit.3:9]]; before περί, [[Jhn.3.26|Jhn.3:26]], [[Act.25.20|Act.25:20]], [[1Ti.6.4|1Ti.6:4]].†
(AS)

G2224.def:
**ζώννυμι and ζωννύω **
[in LXX chiefly for חָגַר ;]
**to gird**: with accusative of person(s), [[Jhn.21.18|Jhn.21:18]] Mid., **to gird oneself**: [[Act.12.8|Act.12:8]] (cf. ἀνα-, δια-, περι-, ὑπο-ζώννυμι).†
(AS)

G2206.def:
**ζηλόω**, -ῶ
[in LXX chiefly for קָנָא pi. ;]
1. **to burn with envy or jealousy, to be jealousy**: absol., [[Act.7.9; 17.5|Act.7:9 17:5]], [[1Co.13.4|1Co.13:4]], [[Jas.4.2|Jas.4:2]] (R, mg., cf. Mayor, in l).
2. **to seek or desire eagerly**: with accusative of thing(s), [[1Co.12.31; 14.1; 14.39|1Co.12:31 14:1 14:39]] (cf. [[Sir.50.18|Sir.50:18]], [[Wis.1.12|Wis.1:12]]); with accusative of person(s), [[2Co.11.2|2Co.11:2]], [[Gal.4.17|Gal.4:17]]; pass., [[Gal.4.18|Gal.4:18]]†
(AS)

G2203.def:
**Ζεύς **
genitive, Διός, dative, Διΐ, accusative, Δία (Δίαν, D, al.),
**Zeus **(Lat. Jupiter): [[Act.14.12-13|Act.14:12-13]]†
(AS)

G2204.def:
**ζέω **
[in LXX for רוּם, רָתַח, metaphorically, [[4Ma.18.20|4Ma.18:20]] ;]
**to boil, be hot**; metaphorically, of anger, **love, zeal**: ptcp., **fervent**: τ. πνεύματι, [[Act.18.25|Act.18:25]], [[Rom.12.11|Rom.12:11]].†
(AS)

G2299.def:
**θεά**, -ᾶς, ἡ
(fem. of θεός, which see),
**a goddess**: [[Act.19.27|Act.19:27]]†
(AS)

G2207.def:
**ζηλωτής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ζηλόω), [in LXX for קַנָּא (θεὸς ζ.), [[Exo.20.5; 34.14|Exo.20:5 34:14]], [[Deu.4.24; 5.9; 6.15|Deu.4:24 5:9 6:15]]; קַנּוֹא, [[Nam.1.2|Nam.1:2]] (θεός); pl., I [[Est.8.72|Est.8:72]] ζ. τῶν νόμων, [[2Ma.4.2|2Ma.4:2]]τὸν ζ. Φινεές, [[4Ma.18.12|4Ma.18:12]] (cf. [[Num.25.11|Num.25:11]])* ;]
1. in cl. an emulator, zealous admirer (Plat., al.).
2. **eagerly desirous, zealous**;
(a) absol., as in OT, ll. with;
(b) with genitive obj.: (zealous to acquire or to defend), [[1Co.14.12|1Co.14:12]], [[Tit.2.14|Tit.2:14]], [[1Pe.3.13|1Pe.3:13]]; τ. νόμου (2Mac, l.with), [[Act.21.20|Act.21:20]] παραδόσεων, [[Gal.1.14|Gal.1:14]] with genitive of person(s), θεοῦ, [[Act.22.3|Act.22:3]]
3. **In FlJ, NT, a Zealot, member of the Jewish party so called**: as surname of the Apostle Simon, [[Luk.6.15|Luk.6:15]], [[Act.1.13|Act.1:13]].†
(AS)

G2271.def:
**ἡσυχία**, -ας, ἡ
(ἡσύχιος, which see), [in LXX for אִישׁוֹן, שָׁלֵו, etc. ;]
1. **quietness**: [[2Th.3.12|2Th.3:12]]
2. **stillness, silence**: [[Act.22.2|Act.22:2]], [[1Ti.2.11-12|1Ti.2:11-12]] †
(AS)

G2209.def:
**ζημία**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for עָנַשׁ; עֹנֶשׁ ni. and cognate forms ;]
**damage, loss**: [[Act.27.10, 21|Act.27:10, 21]] [[Php.3.8|Php.3:8]]; opposite to κέρδος, [[Php.3.7|Php.3:7]]†
(AS)

G2202.def:
**ζευκτήριος**, -α -ον
(ζεύγνυμι),
fit for joining. As subst.,
(a) ζευκτήριον, τό = ζυγόν, **a yoke**;
(b) **ζευκτηρία, -ας, ἡ = ζεύγλη, the crossbar of a double rudder**: [[Act.27.40|Act.27:40]] (found nowhere else).†
(AS)

G2294.def:
1. **courage, boldness **, (Homer), attic; θ. τινός **courage to do ** a thing, (Aeschulus Tragicus)
2. **that which gives courage **, θάρση **grounds of confidence **, (Euripides)
3. in bad sense, **audacity **, (Iliad by Homer): compare θράσος. (ML)

G2273.def:
1. = ἦ τοι, **now surely, truly, verily **, (Iliad by Homer); after ἀλλ᾽ εἰ . ., **nevertheless **, (Iliad by Homer)
2. = ἤτοι, **either in truth **, followed by ἤ, **or **, (Herdotus Historicus), etc. (ML)

G2275.def:
**ἥττημα**, -τος, τό
[in LXX for מַס, [[Isa.31.8|Isa.31:8]] * ;]
**defect, loss, defeat**: [[Rom.11.12|Rom.11:12]] (cf. Isa, l.with), [[1Co.6.7|1Co.6:7]] (cf. Field, _Notes_, 160 f., 171 f.; Lft., _Notes_, 212).†
(AS)

G2276.def:
**ἥσσων** (Rec. ἥττ-, the Attic literary form), ἧσσων,
**inferior, less**; neut., τὸ ἧ., adverbially, **less**: [[2Co.12.15|2Co.12:15]] εἰς τὸ ἧ., **for the worse **(opposite to κρεῖττον): [[1Co.11.17|1Co.11:17]]†
(AS)

G2278.def:
**ἠχέω**, -ῶ
(ἦχος), [in LXX for הָמָה, etc. ;]
**to sound**: [[1Co.13.1|1Co.13:1]] (cf. ἐξ-, κατ-ηχέω).†
(AS)

G2259.def:
**ἡνίκα **
rel. adv. of time,
**at which time, when**; before αν, with subjc., **whensoever**: [[2Co.3.15-16|2Co.3:15-16]]†
(AS)

G2292.def:
**θαρρέω**, -ῶ
(later form of θαρσέω), [in LXX: [[Pro.1.21|Pro.1:21]], [[Bar.4.21, 27|Bar.4:21, 27]], from LXX [[Bar.6.16|Bar.6:16]], (17), [[4Ma.13.11|4Ma.13:11]] [[4Mac.17.4|4Mac 17:4]] * ;]
**to be of good cheer or courage, to be confident**: [[2Co.5.6; 5.8|2Co.5:6 5:8]], [[Heb.13.6|Heb.13:6]]; τ. πεποιθήσει, [[2Co.10.2|2Co.10:2]] before εἰς, [[2Co.10.1|2Co.10:1]] ἐν, [[2Co.7.16|2Co.7:16]]†
_SYN._: τολμάω. "θ. has reference more to the character, τ. to its manifestation " (Thayer, see word τολμάω) (AS)

G2236.def:
**ἥδιστα**, see: ἡδέως.
**ἡδέως **
_adv._ (ἡδύς, sweet), [in LXX: [[Pro.3.24|Pro.3:24]] (עָרַב), etc. ;]
**gladly, with pleasure**: [[Mrk.6.20; 12.37|Mrk.6:20 12:37]], [[2Co.11.19|2Co.11:19]]; superlat., ἥδιστα, very gladly (B1., § 11, 3), [[2Co.12.9; 12.15|2Co.12:9 12:15]].†
(AS)

G2274.def:
**ἡττάω**, -ῶ
(ἡσσ-, [[2Co.12.13|2Co.12:13]], see: ἥσσων) [in LXX for חָתַת, etc. ;]
pass.,
1. **to be inferior**: before ὑπέρ, [[2Co.12.13|2Co.12:13]]
2. **to be overcome**: absol., [[2Pe.2.20|2Pe.2:20]] with dative, [[2Pe.2.19|2Pe.2:19]]†
(AS)

G2282.def:
**θάλπω **
[in LXX for סָכַן, etc. ;]
**to heat, warm**; metaphorically,
(a) **to inflame **(Trag.);
(b) **to foster, cherish**: [[Eph.5.29|Eph.5:29]], [[1Th.2.7|1Th.2:7]].†
(AS)

G2245.def:
**ἡλίκος**, -η, -ον
1. prop., as big as, as old as.
2. As indirect interrog., **what sized, what, how great, how small **(the sense to be determined by the context): [[Col.2.1|Col.2:1]], [[Jas.3.5|Jas.3:5]], [[Gal.6.11|Gal.6:11]] (WH, mg.; πηλ-, WH, txt., RV).†
(AS)

G2263.def:
**ἤρεμος-ον **
[in LXX [[Est.3.13|Est.3:13]] A* ;]
**quiet, tranquil **(Luc., al.): [[1Ti.2.2|1Ti.2:2]]†
**SYN**: ἡσύχιος, q.v
(AS)

G2272.def:
**ἡσύχιος**, -α, -ον
(= the more frequently ἥσυχος; cf. [[Wis.18.14|Wis.18:14]], [[Sir.25.20|Sir.25:20]]), [in LXX: [[Isa.66.2|Isa.66:2]] (רוּחַ נָכֶה)* ;]
**quiet, tranquil**: [[1Ti.2.2|1Ti.2:2]], [[1Pe.3.4|1Pe.3:4]].†
_SYN._: ἤρεμος, of tranquillity arising from without; ἡ., from within (see Ellic. on 1Ti, l.with; but also see CGT, ib.).† (AS)

G2261.def:
**ἤπιος**, -α, -ον
**mild, gentle**: [[1Th.2.7|1Th.2:7]] (WH, R, mg., νήπιος); before πρός, [[2Ti.2.24|2Ti.2:24]]†
(AS)

G2217.def:
**ζόφος**, -ου, ὁ
(akin to γνόφος, which see), [in Sm.: [[Exo.10.22|Exo.10:22]], [[Job.28.3|Job.28:3]], [[Psa.11.2; 91.6|Psa.11:2 91:6]], [[Isa.59.9|Isa.59:9]] * ;]
**in Hom, the gloom of the under-world; hence, darkness, deep gloom **(poët. and late prose writers): [[Heb.12.18|Heb.12:18]], [[2Pe.2.4; 2.17|2Pe.2:4 2:17]], [[Jude.6,13|Ju 6 13]].†
ὁμίχλη, -ης, ἡ,
[in LXX for עֲרָפֶל, etc. ;]
**a mist**: [[2Pe.2.17|2Pe.2:17]]
_SYN._: νέφος, νεφέλη, both thicker than ὁ (AS)

G2226.def:
**ζῷον** (Rec. ζῶον, see LS, see word), -ου, τό
(ζωός, alive), [in LXX for חַי (chiefly) and cognate forms; frequently in Wis ;]
**a living creature, an animal**: [[Rev.4.6-9; 5.6|Rev.4:6-9 5:6]] ff. [[Rev.6.1|Rev.6:1]] ff. [[Rev.7.11; 14.3; 15.7; 19.4|Rev.7:11 14:3 15:7 19:4]]; ζῴων τ. αἷμα, [[Heb.13.11|Heb.13:11]] ἄλογα ζ., [[2Pe.2.12|2Pe.2:12]], [[Jude.10|Ju 10]].†
_SYN._: θηρίον, in which the brutal, bestial element is emphasized, and which is never used of sacrificial animals. On the other hand, ζ. is the more comprehensive, as expressing the vital element common to the whole anima] creation (see Tr., _Syn._, LXXxi; Cremer, 274). (AS)

G2200.def:
**ζεστός**, -ή, -όν
(ζέω) [in Aq.: [[Lev.6.21|Lev.6:21]] in Al.: [[Lev.7.12|Lev.7:12]] * ;]
**boiling hot **(Strab., al.): metaphorically, [[Rev.3.15-16|Rev.3:15-16]]†
(AS)
